## Vendored TipTap + marked — pinned for TBAR-M4.
##
## TipTap v3 is the current stable line of the TipTap rich-text
## framework (a thin wrapper around ProseMirror). This vendor bundle
## combines the TipTap core ``Editor`` plus the StarterKit (the
## standard collection of headings / lists / code / paragraph nodes
## the editor needs to render briefs) with the ``marked`` markdown
## parser, so the editor can accept a markdown string and mount a
## read-only TipTap editor on top of the rendered HTML.
##
## TipTap does NOT ship a pre-built UMD bundle on npm — the package
## ships ESM + CommonJS only. To honour the editor's vendored
## ``<script>``-tag loading pattern we produce the UMD by bundling
## the npm packages once with esbuild and committing the resulting
## file. The bundling step is a one-off described in the
## "Reproduction" section below; ``editor-build`` does NOT depend on
## npm or node at build time.
##
## Source packages (pinned via npm registry):
##
##   Package: @tiptap/core
##   Version: 3.23.6
##   Tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/@tiptap/core/-/core-3.23.6.tgz
##
##   Package: @tiptap/starter-kit
##   Version: 3.23.6
##   Tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/@tiptap/starter-kit/-/starter-kit-3.23.6.tgz
##
##   Package: @tiptap/pm
##   Version: 3.23.6
##   Tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/@tiptap/pm/-/pm-3.23.6.tgz
##   Note: pulled in transitively by @tiptap/core, vendored inside
##   the bundle.
##
##   Package: marked
##   Version: 18.0.4
##   Tarball: https://registry.npmjs.org/marked/-/marked-18.0.4.tgz
##
## License: MIT for all three packages
## (https://github.com/ueberdosis/tiptap/blob/main/LICENSE,
##  https://github.com/markedjs/marked/blob/master/LICENSE.md).
##
## Files (SHA-256):
##
##   isonim-tiptap.umd.min.js  669bf0f58cf67a33073cf38e3c880edb9c7cd3f48c1d92e29f4afb091951ce23  402801 bytes
##   entry.js                  (source of truth for the reproduction step; not loaded by the editor)
##
## The vendoring procedure (reproducible from a clean shell):
##
##   tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
##   cd "$tmpdir"
##   npm init -y
##   npm install @tiptap/core@3.23.6 @tiptap/starter-kit@3.23.6 marked@18.0.4
##   npm install --save-dev esbuild
##   cp <repo>/isonim/src/isonim/editor/vendor/tiptap/entry.js entry.js
##   ./node_modules/.bin/esbuild entry.js \
##     --bundle --minify --format=iife \
##     --global-name=IsoNimTipTapWrapper \
##     --outfile=isonim-tiptap.umd.min.js
##   cp isonim-tiptap.umd.min.js \
##     <repo>/isonim/src/isonim/editor/vendor/tiptap/isonim-tiptap.umd.min.js
##   shasum -a 256 <repo>/isonim/src/isonim/editor/vendor/tiptap/isonim-tiptap.umd.min.js
##
## The shasums above MUST match. If they don't, npm has shipped a
## different tarball under the same version tag (this happens when
## someone re-publishes a unique build); pin to a different patch
## version after auditing the diff and bump this manifest.
##
## NO runtime npm dependency. The editor bundle copies the UMD file
## into `build/editor/vendor/tiptap/` (see the
## `isonim-examples/Justfile` `editor-build` recipe) and the editor
## HTML page loads it via `<script src="vendor/tiptap/isonim-tiptap.umd.min.js">`
## before the Nim-emitted `editor.js`.
##
## The bundle attaches a single global, ``window.IsoNimTipTap``, with
## the following shape (see `entry.js` for the canonical source):
##
##   window.IsoNimTipTap = {
##     version: "tiptap-2.x + marked-18.x (vendored)",
##     Editor,                 // @tiptap/core
##     StarterKit,             // @tiptap/starter-kit
##     marked,                 // marked
##     mountViewer(container, markdown), // read-only mount
##     unmount(container),
##     isEditableContainer(container) -> bool
##   }
##
## The TBAR-M4 spec-pane mount consumes ``IsoNimTipTap.mountViewer``;
## the Playwright probe asserts ``window.IsoNimTipTap`` is defined
## after page load.
